subject: how a Prioritize/Abort decision from one timing inconsistency is applied consistently across middleware, kernel and network schedulers

groups.why_chosen: One inconsistency verdict, computed once at a Handler node, is re-stamped with the same two accent colours and Prioritize/Abort labels at three completely different scheduler layers below.
groups.what_to_learn: Compute the verdict once at the top and re-draw its two accent colours plus Prioritize/Abort text at every layer below, even as each layer's queue icon changes shape — but reused bare letters force reading by position, not name.
